en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the gym.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's do some muscle training
Let's renovate the place
I'm tired...

Alright!
Let's do 500 push ups!

We're gonna go non-stop, 
so get ready!
Huh? That's too many?

500 should be a piece of cake for my
sidekick! Don't complain, just do it!

The impossible is possible!
All you gotta do is make it so!

What, you wanna make this place more
comfortable or something?
What if you start liking it here?

Weren't we gonna work together 
and escape this academy?

Huh? You haven't even 
done anything yet.

If you keep talking like that, I won't
hold back, even if you are my sidekick!

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Kaito looks deep in thought...
(Damn it...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Kaito's inner thoughts...?
